usedFor: Backup teams use Acronis Cyber Protect to run “Force Update Agents” when updates should happen right away.

bestTemplate.name: “Force Update Agents” in Acronis Cyber Protect
bestTemplate.why: It forces updates immediately, so a team can start it the moment it needs to.

watchOut: Automations run on an app event or a schedule, so decide what should start “Force Update Agents”.
